payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image retain recognizable photographic subject matter and appearance?
node.criteria: Pass if recognizable photographic subject matter and appearance remain; fail if they do not; unknown if evidence is insufficient. This observation alone does not establish progress or fulfillment.
node.binding: Assess the edited image for photographic subject matter and appearance. Do not treat mere retention of the source scene as progress toward the requested edit.
